method.alignment: Same 1672x941 origin and integer pixel coordinates; no crop, registration, warp, resampling, gamma, ICC, EXIF, exposure or gain adjustment to either input.
method.comparisons: Unweighted encoded RGB differences. JPEG has no reference alpha; candidate RGBA hashes remain separate. No SSIM/perceptual score or success threshold is defined.
method.partition: All pixels accounted for exactly once. Reporting regions are not edit masks or exclusions. Cabinet ROI is additional, not added twice to the window total.
method.patches: Half-open rectangles, encoded Y'=(2126R+7152G+722B)/10000, exact rational least-squares plane, population RMS. New Lower patches are observations for protocol authoring and have no admitted tolerance.
method.physical_limit: Image statistics and decorative artwork supply no display, accessibility, instrument material, audio or physical fidelity result.
method.state_limit: Current gallery is an actual runtime scene, not a frozen-state before/after comparison; held keys, correct gain direction, live values/tools, truthful labels and runtime footer all remain in raw differences.

window_without_cabinet_accounting.boundary: Decomposition only; cabinet stays in the complete-window report and no exterior pixels are excluded from a parity claim.
